name: jobward
description: Jobward — il workspace del candidato per organizzare la ricerca del lavoro.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:contrast && pnpm check:config && pnpm check:brand && pnpm test:identity && pnpm db:check && pnpm db:upgrade-test && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.check:contrast: node scripts/check-contrast.mjs > /dev/null && echo "Contrasto WCAG dei token: OK" || (node scripts/check-contrast.mjs | grep FAIL; exit 1)
scripts.db:upgrade-test: node scripts/test-migration-upgrade.mjs && node scripts/test-migration-m3c2.mjs && node scripts/test-migration-m3tasks.mjs
